name: simulate-remaining-expense-boundaries-r
why: Measured reach for the extracted annual debt/LTC, healthcare/ACA/Medicare, and guardrail-funding planners. readingTheCounts: A member count proves that at least one line in the named range executed. The reach command additionally fails on any cold executable whole line inside a reached range. JavaScript line coverage cannot distinguish every ternary, nullish, optional-chain, or compound-condition operand sharing one physical line, so cold sub-line regions and focused helper/delegation tests remain complementary evidence.
